title: Listen to the Grand Ole Opry’s Saturday Night Show Dedicated to Dolly Parton
summary: SiriusXM is paying tribute to the legendary singer, songwriter, and actress who died at the age of 80.
body_markdown:
SiriusXM is paying tribute to the life, music, and legacy of[Dolly Parton](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/dolly-parton) with The Dolly Parton Tribute Channel (Ch. 105) on car radios and the SiriusXM app.


[The Dolly Parton Tribute Channel The Queen of Country’s songs, stories & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogDollyParton)


### **The Dolly Parton Tribute Channel on SiriusXM**


The limited-run channel features Dolly’s career-spanning music, exclusive stories, and hand-picked favorite songs. The Dolly Parton Tribute Channel launches on August 25 at 8pm ET with a live call-in show hosted by Cody Alan. Dial877-963-4726 to call in.


The Queen of Country and pop-culture icon passed away Tuesday, August 25 at the age of 80, her family said in a statement.


Throughout her remarkable seven-decade career, Parton became one of the most beloved and influential artists in music history, writing and singing enduring classics including “Jolene,” “9 to 5,” and “I Will Always Love You.” She was inducted into both the Country Music Hall of Fame and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and won 11 Grammy Awards as well as the Recording Academy’s Lifetime Achievement Award.


### **Listen to Dolly Parton Tributes**


Listen to tributes to Dolly on SiriusXM’s country music channels and more in your car or on the SiriusXM app.


Dolly Parton Tributes Live on SiriusXM:


- [Willie’s Roadhouse](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/willies-roadhouse) host Dallas Wayne from 4pm-8pm ET
- [Outlaw Country](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/outlaw-country) host Elizabeth Cook from 8pm-10pm ET
- [The Highway](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-highway) host Buzz Brainard at 4pm ET


Be part of the tribute: Share a video or voice recording of the memories, music, and moments you’ll always remember at[siriusxm.com/tribute](http://siriusxm.com/tribute) .


Check back for more programming updates soon.

### **Remembering Dolly Parton**


Born in Tennessee in 1946, Parton rose from humble beginnings to become a defining voice in country music and a global entertainment icon.


Beyond her own recordings, Parton’s songwriting left an indelible mark on popular music. Her composition “I Will Always Love You” became a No. 1 country hit for Parton before Whitney Houston’s rendition became a worldwide phenomenon. Parton’s career also extended to movies including *9 to 5* , *Steel Magnolias* , and more.


Parton’s impact reached far beyond entertainment. Her Imagination Library, launched in 1995, has provided books to children around the world as part of her decades-long commitment to literacy and philanthropy.


Tune in to SiriusXM to celebrate Dolly Parton’s music, life, and enduring legacy.
